product_wide_rationale: Governs the one session route into an implementation worktree, so its capture and resume shapes bind every Domain rather than one runtime Domain.
summary: concord_work_start accepts a resume shape naming an existing item by work identity. The work-resume read derives the item's active worktree entry from the Product, Project, and work identity, applies the bootstrap origin gate, and refuses unknown, terminal, unclaimed, or out-of-scope work typed. The adapter runs the same session-prepare, move, and read-back tail as a capture and records nothing.
title: work start resumes an existing item by work identity
